item.title: Outlander season 8: Don’t miss a single episode
item.description: Outlander has made a name for itself as a series of fiery romance and bloody battles. The characters have travelled not only across countries but also across time, taking part in political intrigue, wars and uprisings. Now, the time has come for the end – the eighth instalment of Outlander is the finale of the saga about 20th-century nurse Claire and 18th-century Scottish Highlander Jamie. item.title: Watch the F1 Australian Grand Prix 2026 on Apple TV
item.description: The 2026 Formula 1 season has just begun, with the first race taking place in Melbourne this weekend. If you’re a US-based fan, you can catch all the F1 events with Apple TV. The platform not only delivers feature films about F1 but also broadcasts races, which its users can stream live or watch on demand. item.description: For all its talk of wireless this and that, tech gear is still a bunch of lumpy chargers and snakes of different cables, plus at least one adapter, and, for the road warrior, a mouse and portable power bank. item.title: Google’s warning over battery-draining Android apps
item.description: Last November, Google announced a new “bad behaviour threshold” to app developers. Apps that excessively drained users’ battery life could be excluded from recommended results or flagged with a warning. As of the start of this month, that feature has gone live. Google has started letting its Play Store alert users to apps that can consume an unusually high amount of battery power due to high background activity, reports 9to5Google.
